name: Taming the Beast
summary: Quel'ana Quickgale teaches you the bond between beast and master. Your first challenge is to tame a Windsong Crawler near the waters of Zephras.

sections.title: First Bond
sections.body: You begin with the Taming Rod and a Windsong Crawler. Tame one near a body of water, practice your skills, then return the rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar. For now, your path toward mastery starts with this creature.

faq.q: What does Quel'ana ask me to tame?
faq.answer: Quel'ana asks you to tame a Windsong Crawler near a body of water on Zephras.

faq.q: What is the Taming Rod for?
faq.answer: The Taming Rod is used to tame a Windsong Crawler.

faq.q: Where do I find a Windsong Crawler?
faq.answer: Windsong Crawlers are found near bodies of water on Zephras.

faq.q: Who gave me the Taming Rod?
faq.answer: Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar gives you the Taming Rod.

faq.q: Why am I learning to tame a beast?
faq.answer: Learning the bond between beast and master is the first step toward mastery for your class.

attribution: In-game quest text: Taming the Beast
